subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/response-pane.tsx:112-121 renders only running[0], hiding other supported transfers for the same request. Independently reproduced with the real ApiClient and synthetic deferred results: Send, switch to another request tab, return, then Send again. Two sends and two RunningViews exist, but only one progress region and one Cancel request control render; clicking it cancels only the first ID. The second transfer cannot be selected for cancellation while the first remains active. The core explicitly supports four concurrent sends of one document (crates/desktop-core/tests/workbench_execution/main.rs:546), and the legacy editor rendered every running entry. Acceptance: expose progress and independent cancellation for every active run of the displayed request, including while inspecting History. Add a component regression using two deferred sends across a tab round trip; assert each active run can be cancelled by its own ID exactly once, without cancelling another run or sending anything again.
